verified_facts: 52 fixed-network and 18 FWA providers supplied January 2026 orderable-service data
the premise base uses OS AddressBase Premium and Islands Epoch 123
the files are open under OGL conditions and use CSV with double-quote text delimiters
the all-premises postcode release must be revision r2 after the 7 July 2026 CW/CV and MK/ME correction
121 r2 all-premises postcode files contain 1,741,096 rows
121 residential postcode files contain 1,606,191 rows
All Premises, All Matched Premises and raw number fields are not supplied at postcode level
unmatched premises are classified as unclassified and coverage is fixed-line unless FWA is explicitly named
version JSON identifies the relationship CSV filename, publication date and relationship epoch
Identifier1Source and Identifier2Source each carry source product name, publication date, feature type and identifier type
source epoch names may be omitted only when the source value is null
relationship validity must retain both source-side publication identities
the product is divided into 11 relationship ZIP packages
each ZIP includes relationship CSV, version JSON, OGL licence and relationship-description PDF
the release is full Great Britain supply on a six-week cycle
package member completeness is required before a relationship archive is accepted
ONSPD links current and terminated postcodes through point-in-polygon allocation
boundary-straddling postcodes use the mean grid reference of addresses
postcode products are quarterly one-metre grid-reference supplies
CSV files contain field headings and double-quoted comma-delimited values
OSGRDIND codes distinguish building-level, approximate, postcode-mean, imputed and sector-mean positions
code 8 is a terminated pre-Gridlink postcode using its last known ONS grid reference
code 9 means no grid reference is available
grid quality must be preserved and cannot be converted into parcel certainty
